periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline, angled downwards toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval morphology with a high aspect ratio where height significantly exceeds width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point of the patch shifted significantly inferior to the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral spacing between the dark ear regions relative to the total cranial width, positioned at the 10 and 2 o'clock positions.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior margins of the ears.
